evidence.title: Body found in Colombia in search for missing British man Anton Green

occurrences.checkable_against: Colombian police discovery records and identification findings
occurrences.quote_span: The family of a British man missing in Colombia have been told a body has been found in the search for him.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Body believed to be Anton Green found in Colombia

occurrences.checkable_against: Family appeal records and BBC interview with Anton Green's relatives

occurrences.subject: Body believed to be Anton Green found in Colombia
